labs.lab_name: Center for Information & Research on Civic Learning and Engagement (CIRCLE)
labs.location: Barnum Hall, Jonathan M. Tisch College of Civic Life, Tufts University, Medford, MA 02155
labs.research_summary: Tisch College research center on how young people in the United States learn to take part in democracy, covering youth voting, civic learning and youth media.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 director, 10 other staff (researchers, operations, communications, data, administration), 3 fellows and student assistants
labs.join_notes: The hiring page currently lists one request for proposals for a part-time data consultant (January to June 2027, about $19,000 budget); proposals go by email to circle@tufts.edu with a November 20, 2026 deadline. It also offers an email list for future openings.
labs.notes: The 3 fellows and assistants include a doctoral student, a research fellow and an undergraduate communications assistant. The phone is the number shown in the footer and for the communications manager. The hiring page was fetched (1 of 3 extra fetches).
